as_told.title: John Dee claimed to speak with angels at Queen Elizabeth's court
as_told.place_text: England, court of Queen Elizabeth I

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of John Dee, whom he describes as Queen Elizabeth's chief spy and magician in 16th century England. Michels says Dee claimed to talk with angels through a special language, called Enochian, and that he blurred the line between magic and speaking with angels, which Michels links to his own talk of contact with other kinds of beings.
